                while stack:

                        a,b=x+dx,y+dy
                        if 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and grid[a][b] in (1,2) and (a,b) not in seen:

                if not any(set(comp)==set(z['cells']) for z in lines):
                    rs=[x for x,y in comp]; cs=[y for x,y in comp]
                    lines.append({'cells':comp,'horizontal':min(rs)==max(rs),'r0':min(rs),'r1':max(rs),'c0':min(cs),'c1':max(cs),'n':sum(grid[x][y]==1 for x,y in comp)})
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]==1:g[r][c]=2
    r,c=seed
    seq=([0,3,0,1,2,3,0,1,2,3] if lines[0]['horizontal'] else [1,0,1,2,3,1,0,1,2,3])
    points=[(r,c)]
    for i,line in enumerate(lines):
        m=line['n']+1; d=seq[i]

        r,c=nr,nc; points.append((r,c))
    d=seq[len(lines)-1]
    if d==0:r=H-1
